off.alignment: force command physics_step k matched completed TORQUE_FRAME k+1; ideal target evaluated at frame.time_s
off.reaction_semantics: joint8 incoming transmission wrench, not independent suction contact force
off.model_candidate_semantics: model residual estimate, not measured suction force
off.force_semantics: known force injected on Cube during interval k to k+1

motion.target_semantics: ideal quintic straight line evaluated at each TORQUE_FRAME time_s

fk_qref_reference.semantics: average Cube position implied by each FK q_ref and initial rigid attachment; q_ref in state k+1 is the command for the following interval, not the command applied in interval k; not a direct Cube command or contact measurement
fk_qref_reference.source_filter: both trajectory_adapter.reference_age sources must equal suspended_probe_quintic_joint_ik
fk_qref_reference.active_flag_limitation: adapter flag does not by itself prove no later hold override
